FilingRule.description: A filename rule: a file whose name matches ``pattern`` belongs in the folder that holds the rule.

pattern.description: A glob matched against the file name only (never the folder path), ignoring case. 'requirements*.docx' matches one kind of file; 'meeting-notes*' matches any extension.
pattern.title: Pattern

FilingRule.title: FilingRule

FolderNode.description:
One folder in the library, and what helps match it.

A top-level node is a group; its children are that group's categories, and so on down to the library's
depth. A node named ``*`` stands for any folder at its level and only holds children.

name.description: The folder's name exactly as it is on disk, including any number prefix, such as 'Project Phoenix' or '01 Requirements'. Case is ignored when matching. '*' means any folder at this level, so what it holds applies to all of them.
name.title: Name

description.description: A note about what belongs in this folder, for people reading the file. It is not used for matching and is not sent to any AI.
description.title: Description

hints.description: Keywords whose appearance in a document (any case) suggests this folder. Hints are not inherited by the folders below.
hints.title: Hints

rules.description: Filename rules for this folder, checked before the keyword hints.
rules.title: Rules

FolderNode.title: FolderNode

description:
The contents of ``microfiche-library.json``.

A missing file means no hints and no rules: documents are then matched on folder names alone.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file, so an editor can validate and complete it.
$schema.title: $Schema

groups.description: The library's top-level folders. Their children are the categories, and so on.
groups.title: Groups
